summary: Iteration 4 (Annual pricing + Manage subscription portal) fully verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py — GET /api/plans exposes both price_monthly/price_yearly and lookup_monthly/lookup_yearly (Pro 29/290 pro_monthly/pro_yearly; Business 79/790 business_monthly/business_yearly; Free 0/0 nulls); POST /api/payments/checkout returns a valid https://checkout.stripe.com URL + cs_ session id for pro_yearly, pro_monthly (monthly regression) and business_yearly; POST /api/payments/portal for a fresh user with no paid subscription returns 400 'No active subscription to manage.'; POST /api/payments/portal for the seeded admin (pro plan in DB but no stripe_customer_id) also returns 400 as designed; unauthenticated /payments/portal returns 401/403; fresh free user's 2nd collection still blocked with 402. Frontend E2E (fully automated): registered a fresh random-email user + onboarded via API, logged into /dashboard/settings, verified Billing card (data-testid=billing) with cycle-toggle. YEARLY toggle: plan-pro card shows '$290 /yr' AND '≈ $24/mo · 2 months free' hint (spec: '2 months free' + per-month hint). MONTHLY toggle: plan-pro card shows '$29 /mo'. Clicked upgrade-pro on yearly cycle → redirected to https://checkout.stripe.com hosted page which displayed 'Subscribe to Testify Pro — US$24.17 / month billed annually — Testify Pro Billed annually US$290.00 — Total US$290.00' (confirms YEARLY billing was used). Completed checkout with 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/34, 123, cardholder name, US address 1 Market St / San Francisco / CA / 94105, phone 4155551234. Landed on /payment/success?session_id=cs_test_...; data-testid=payment-success rendered. Returned to /dashboard/settings — data-testid=current-pro visible AND data-testid=manage-subscription button visible. Clicked Manage subscription → navigated to https://billing.stripe.com/p/session/... which loaded showing 'CURRENT SUBSCRIPTION — Testify Pro — $290.00 per year — Your next billing date is August 15, 2027 — Visa •••• 4242 — Cancel subscription' (portal fully functional; no cancellation performed). Monthly upgrade path validated via /api/payments/checkout with lookup_key=pro_monthly returning a valid cs_ session (regression green).

issues: Cosmetic: per-month hint shows '≈ $24/mo' (Math.round(290/12)=24). Actual monthly-equivalent when paid annually is $24.17. Consider Math.floor or displaying '$24.17/mo' to match Stripe's own display of US$24.17 / month billed annually. Non-blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: align Billing.jsx per-month hint (Math.round → toFixed(2)) with Stripe's US$24.17/mo display.

Pre-existing (from iter3, still valid): Register → Onboarding navigation race — new user occasionally lands on /dashboard with an empty overview and no default collection until they manually visit /onboarding. Reproduced again this iteration (worked around by API-completing onboarding then loading /dashboard/settings).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /payments/portal correctly filters payment_transactions by payment_status=paid AND stripe_customer_id != None — good. However there is no idempotency/safeguard against the admin seed being flipped to non-pro through the portal because seed has no stripe_customer_id (400 blocks it), so this is OK. Note: no test coverage for a real Stripe billing_portal.Session error branch — only integration-happy path exercised.
Billing.jsx yearly per-month display uses Math.round(price/12) → shows $24/mo for pro_yearly ($290/12=$24.17). Consider toFixed(2) for accuracy or hide when non-integer.
PLAN_BY_LOOKUP hardcoded in server.py — consider deriving from a single source of truth shared with /plans response to prevent drift when adding future intervals.

The billing portal return_url uses data.origin_url.rstrip('/') + '/dashboard/settings' — verify PortalInput has origin_url required; if omitted the return_url becomes '/dashboard/settings' (Stripe will reject). Not observed in tests since UI always supplies it but worth Pydantic-enforcing.
